name: L&I Contractor License Data - Bond
description: State of Washington, Labor & Industries contractor license and bond data.

columns.name: BusinessName
columns.description: The registered name in which the contractor is doing business as.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseNumber
columns.description: The Contractor License Number is the unique combination of letters, numbers and symbols that are specific and unique to a contractor. This license number is generated by L&I.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCode
columns.description: An abbreviation which identifies the Contractor License Type.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCodeDesc
columns.description: Identification of the type of contractor license.

columns.name: LicenseStatus
columns.description: Abbreviation of the contractor license status.

columns.name: UBI
columns.description: Unified Business Identifier (UBI) is a nine digit number that registers you with several state agencies and allows you to do business in Washington State.

columns.name: BondFirmName
columns.description: The insurer the contractor obtained their bond through.

columns.name: BondAccountID
columns.description: Account Number listed on the contractor's bond.

columns.name: BondAmt
columns.description: The monetary amount the surety is liable for in a bond agreement.

columns.name: ReceivedByL&I
columns.description: The date the contractor's bond was received by the department.

columns.name: BondEffectiveDate
columns.description: The date the bond became effective.

columns.name: BondCancelDate
columns.description: The date the bond was cancelled.

columns.name: BondImpaired
columns.description: Indicates the bond has a payout.

columns.name: BondImpairedDate
columns.description: The date in which the bond was impaired.

Temporal.Posting Frequency: L&I Contractor Insurance Data is updated three times per day: 8:00 a.m., 12:15 p.m., 5:15 p.m
